name: apt-file
description: apt-file is a command line tool for searching files contained in packages for the APT packaging system. You can search in which package a file is included or list the contents of a package without installing or fetching it.

references.note: Original package list; do not run the entire list to install this package.

notes: Migrated from existing repository recipes. Availability varies by OS release and configured repositories; remote installation has not been verified during this redesign.
